1981-03-04 Rupp Arena, Lexington, KY

Share: 

Scheduled: 19:30 | Local Start Time ??:?? / End Time ??:??

Info & Setlist | Venue

Concert was rescheduled from February 10. One of only a handful of River Tour shows for which the complete setlist is not known, taking place in the cavernous Rupp Arena that seats 23,000. The audience tape ends with "Candy's Room", but a review in The Kentucky Kernel of the University of Kentucky adds "Rosalita (Come Out Tonight)", "Jungleland", and final encore "Twist And Shout", and another review in The Louisville Times mentions both "Born To Run" and "Detroit Medley" to give us a 27-song set. Possibly one or two songs are missing from end of the second set and encores. The latter review also notes that "She's The One" was played, but could be a mistake given the song's rarity at the time. Roy plays the piano intro before "The River" and "Once Upon A Time In The West" as a bridge between that song and "Badlands".

Audience tape (incomplete and with "Badlands" cut). A tape circulates with four additional tracks at the end, but these have been identified as sourced from two different shows: "Point Blank" (from April 14), "Ramrod" (from April 9), "Twist And Shout" (from April 14), and "Rockin' All Over The World" (from April 9).
